new_evidence: Grayscale Zcash ETF (ZCSH) has accumulated more than $233M of net inflows since its Aug. 25 launch and held about $890M of net assets as of Sept. 17.
The latest reported large session added about $46.6M, while cumulative ZCSH trading volume exceeded $11B as of Sept. 17.
This is a regulated capital-access channel distinct from the previously recorded CEX-withdrawal clusters, shielded-pool use and NU7 catalyst.
Zcash estimated solrate rose from roughly 25 GSol/s in late August to just under 32 GSol/s, with mining difficulty also at a record, adding a separate supply-side/security participation confirmation.
quality_adjustments: Do not treat the full $233M cumulative ZCSH inflow as fully independent discretionary capital. The Sept. 8 flow exceeded $112M and earlier public disclosures attribute roughly $100M of that session to DCG International Investments via an in-kind ZEC contribution through an authorized participant; this affiliate component is discounted.
The newer ~$46.6M session is not publicly attributed to the same affiliate in the sources retrieved in this run, but ultimate beneficial-owner independence is not proven.
The announced 3-for-1 ZCSH share split is economically neutral and is not counted as value creation or as evidence of incremental ZEC demand.
Fund-flow dollars are not converted one-for-one into an assumed spot-market ZEC purchase quantity because ETF creation mechanics and timing can differ.

market_confirmation.interpretation: Institutional/fund demand is a genuine new confirmation, but derivatives positioning remains large and funding is now positive, so the prior crowding/chase risk has not normalized enough to justify restoring the paper position to its cap after the recent trim.

structural_gate.notes: ZEC remains a native PoW asset with no token-contract honeypot/mint/LP-control gate. Key caveats remain privacy-coin regulatory/exchange-access risk, ongoing issuance, derivative crowding and uncertainty about beneficial-owner independence across observed capital channels.

paper_portfolio.decision: No paper trade. The new ZCSH flow strengthens the ZEC thesis but does not override anti-chase/crowding discipline. Position remains near the 7.5% non-core ceiling and should not be mechanically re-expanded after the Sept. 17 trim.

forward_tests: Whether ZCSH continues to receive net creations after the current price extension and after the Sept. 30 split-adjusted trading begins.
Whether future ZCSH inflows are externally sourced rather than affiliate/in-kind contributions.
Whether ZEC perp open interest and positive funding normalize while spot/fund demand persists.
Whether the fresh CEX-withdrawal wallets continue accumulating without redeposit/linkage evidence.
NU7 testnet on Oct. 6 and targeted mainnet activation on Nov. 5 remain separate implementation checkpoints.
hindsight_policy: Observation frozen prospectively. Do not credit subsequent price moves to a trade because no paper trade was executed in this run.
